name: trek-plugin-visa-manager
description: TREK page plugin for personal passports, visas, visa applications and border crossings.

scripts.dev: npm run build --prefix ../../plugin-sdk && npm run build && node ../../plugin-sdk/dist/cli/trek-plugin.js dev .
scripts.pack: npm run build && node ../../plugin-sdk/dist/cli/trek-plugin.js pack . --out visa-manager.zip
